label: OnCell G3150A-LTE cellular gateway
description: Rugged LTE serial/Ethernet-to-cellular gateway with exactly one 10/100BaseT(X) RJ45 LAN port and one DB9 RS-232/422/485 serial port, plus an RJ45 RS-232 console port. Dual SIM with GuaranLink, IPsec/OpenVPN, NAT and a MAC/IP/port firewall; ATEX Zone 2 rated, -30 to 70 C on the wide-temp models.
